answer: A knoll is the set of keys that signed the same job id within an example 3 epochs. Influence between two keys on that knoll may pass only along their thread, and the desk withholds a delta of an example 75 percent of the pass. The withheld delta is not booked, and the sender's balance is not debited. A thread between keys on different knolls is left whole. A further key that joins the knoll has that same delta withheld on its own thread, and earlier cuts stay.
